prompt: Create a transparent PNG Hebrew graffiti name asset for a memorial mural. Exact text, ONE line in correct logical right-to-left Hebrew reading order: "אייל מבורך טויטו". Exactly three words: אייל | מבורך | טויטו. Characters: א י י ל [space] מ ב ו ר ך [space] ט ו י ט ו. NO HYPHEN, dash, punctuation or other words. Respect spelling and word order exactly; two yods in אייל, final descending ך in מבורך. Bold authentic hand-drawn angular interlocking aerosol graffiti, chunky readable letterforms, navy #082e49 outlines and dimensional shadow, chalk #f5f1da and blue #207ba6 fill with yellow #e6c62e accents, rough spray edges, subtle paint wear and several real downward paint drips. Limited four-ink palette, no other colors. Wide horizontal composition, entire name and all drips inside frame with transparent padding. TRUE transparent background: no wall, no portrait, no flag, no slogan, no backdrop, no checkerboard. This must be original painted graffiti, not typeset clean text.
evidence: Native source and 1080px light/dark renders visually reviewed; original asset retained unchanged.
